US.one_line: Pick Newell cautiously: improving sales offer an edge, but debt and volatility threaten it.
reasons: Newell could beat the wider market as shoppers keep buying household goods.
Its sales grew, and many shares traded during the price rise.
It still loses money and owes substantial debt, so this is uncertain.
good_news: Trading volume reached 2.78 times its recent average.
bad_news: The latest quarter recorded a net loss.
The price already jumped 15.06% in a day.
Heavy debt and sharp price swings increase the risk.

IN.one_line: Buy Marico delivery shares, but use a strict exit plan.
reasons: Marico has recently risen more than the main market index.
Its latest profit result was slightly better than expected.
The recent jump means the price could fall back quickly.
good_news: Revenue grew 22.9% from a year earlier in the latest quarter.
Latest-quarter profit was ₹6.3 billion and operating margin was 19.3%.
Earnings beat estimates by 2.5%, followed by a 5.6% next-day rise.
bad_news: The relative-strength reading is high at 68.8.
The share already rose 5.79% today and 8.12% this month.
